verdict.rationale: telli documents API keys issued from Settings > Developer and sent as bearer tokens. Nothing in the evidence shows those keys can be scoped, permission-limited, or restricted to least privilege for an agent, so a plain API key is only adjacent to this story. Missing for 10: scoped or permissioned API keys, least-privilege credential controls, and per-agent credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
